invariants.rationale: The method is searching for a tileset matching the provided name using name.equals(), which will throw a NullPointerException if name is null. It's likely that calling code avoids passing null here.
By String contract, if name is non-null, its length is always non-negative. Useful for defensive code that might later check for empty names.
At method entry, name can be any non-null string—empty or non-empty after trimming.
